reviews.policyBody: Every review waits for a moderator while pre-moderation is on. Approve what is a fair account of living there; reject or hide insults, false claims of fact and anyone's personal data, and write the reason — the author and the owner read it. Owners can reply and report, never hide.

actions.approveBody: It appears on the building's listings at once, with the label “verified tenant”.
actions.rejectBody: It is never published. The author reads your reason.
actions.hideBody: It disappears from the public pages. The owner and the author read your reason; it can be restored.
actions.restoreTitle: Make this review of {building} public again?
actions.restoreBody: It reappears on the building's listings.
actions.dismissBody: The review stays as it is; the report is closed.
actions.reasonHint: Shown to the author and the owner. Up to 1,000 characters.
actions.invalidState: Someone already decided on this review. The list has been refreshed.

handoffs.intro: Units getbuild transferred with the buyer's wish to rent out. getbuild shows the buyer the invitation; getproperty never contacts the buyer itself.
handoffs.emptyHint: They appear when getbuild sends a transfer with rental intent.
handoffs.attempts: {count, plural, =0 {no attempts} one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}
handoffs.resendBody: getbuild receives a new single-use link now and the previous one stops working.
handoffs.invalidState: This invitation is no longer waiting (claimed, declined or expired).
